mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_air_line_t (flight_route_id, device_code, flight_route_name, kmz_file_name, kmz_storage_path, type, area_infos, tenant_id, industry_code, create_time, create_user, update_user, access_node, accept_node, extra_field, warning_type_id, app_ver_code, kmz_access_path, uav_Allowed, snapshot_Id,flight_main_type,uav_code,is_expand_watermark,air_mileage , start_nest_code,end_nest_code,frog_leap,uav_model_code) VALUES (#{flightRouteId}, #{deviceCode}, #{flightRouteName}, #{fileName}, #{storagePath}, #{type}, #{areaInfos}, #{tenantId}, #{industryCode}, NOW(), #{createUser}, #{updateUser}, #{accessNode}, #{acceptNode}, #{kmzJson}, #{warningTypeIds}, #{appVerCode}, #{fileAccessPath}, #{uavAllowed}, #{snapshotId},#{flightMainType},#{uavCode},#{isExpandWatermark},#{airMileage},#{startNestCode},#{endNestCode},#{frogLeap},#{uavModelCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE vm_air_line_t SET device_code = #{deviceCode}, flight_route_name = #{flightRouteName}, kmz_file_name = #{fileName}, kmz_storage_path = #{storagePath}, type = #{type}, area_infos = #{areaInfos}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, industry_code = #{industryCode}, update_time = NOW(), update_user = #{updateUser}, access_node = #{accessNode}, accept_node = #{acceptNode}, extra_field = #{kmzJson}, kmz_access_path = #{fileAccessPath}, uav_Allowed = #{uavAllowed}, snapshot_Id = #{snapshotId}, warning_type_id = #{warningTypeIds}, is_expand_watermark = #{isExpandWatermark}, air_mileage = #{airMileage} WHERE flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId}
mapper.select: SELECT flight_route_id AS flightRouteId, flight_route_name AS flightRouteName, kmz_storage_path AS kmzUrl, kmz_file_name AS kmzFileName, type AS type, t.device_code AS deviceCode, t.update_time AS modifiedTime, warning_type_id AS warningTypeId, extra_field AS kmzJson, t.access_node AS accessNode, ct.longitude as uavNestLongitude, ct.latitude as uavNestLatitude, dt.longitude as uavLongitude, dt.latitude as uavLatitude, t.uav_Allowed AS uavAllowed, snapshot_Id AS snapshotId, kmz_access_path AS kmzAccessUrl, t.industry_Code AS industryCode, t.is_expand_watermark AS isExpandWatermark, t.air_mileage AS airMileage, t.start_nest_code as startNestCode, t.end_nest_code as endNestCode, t.frog_leap as frogLeap, t.uav_model_code as uavModelCode FROM vm_air_line_t t LEFT JOIN vm_uav_nest_device_info ct ON ct.device_code = t.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t dt ON dt.device_code = t.device_code WHERE flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId}

SELECT flight_route_id AS flightRouteId, flight_route_name AS flightRouteName, kmz_storage_path AS kmzUrl, kmz_file_name AS kmzFileName, type AS type, t.device_code AS deviceCode, t.update_time AS modifiedTime, warning_type_id AS warningTypeId, extra_field AS kmzJson, t.create_user AS createUser, t.access_node AS accessNode, ct.longitude as uavNestLongitude, ct.latitude as uavNestLatitude, dt.longitude as uavLongitude, dt.latitude as uavLatitude, t.uav_Allowed AS uavAllowed, snapshot_Id AS snapshotId, kmz_access_path AS kmzAccessUrl, t.industry_Code AS industryCode, t.tenant_id AS tenantId FROM vm_air_line_t t LEFT JOIN vm_uav_nest_device_info ct ON ct.device_code = t.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t dt ON dt.device_code = t.device_code WHERE flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_air_line_col_t (user_id, create_time, create_user, status, collect_id, col_type,industry_Code) VALUES (#{userId}, now(), #{airEditDto.createUser}, 0, #{airEditDto.flightRouteId}, 1, #{industryCode})
mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM vm_air_task_t WHERE plan_id IN (SELECT plan_id FROM vm_air_plan_t WHERE flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId}) AND medium_status != '0'
select pt.plan_name from vm_air_line_t lt left join vm_air_plan_t pt on pt.flight_route_id = lt.flight_route_id where lt.flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId} and pt.delete_flag = 0

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(device_name) AS combined_device_names FROM (SELECT device_name FROM vm_uav_nest_device_info WHERE device_code = #{deviceCode} UNION SELECT device_name FROM vm_uav_device_info_t WHERE device_code = #{deviceCode} and delete_flag = 0) AS combined_devices;

SELECT pt.plan_name FROM vm_air_line_t lt LEFT JOIN vm_air_plan_t pt ON pt.flight_route_id = lt.flight_route_id LEFT JOIN vm_air_task_t t ON t.plan_id = pt.plan_id WHERE lt.flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId} and t.task_status = 3 AND pt.delete_flag = 0

SELECT t2.algorithm_name as algorithmName,t1.warning_type_id as algorithmCode from vm_air_algorithm_t t1 LEFT JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t t2 ON t1.warning_type_id = t2.algorithm_code where t1.delete_flag = '0' and flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId} and t1.status = '0'
select device_code from vm_uav_device_info_t where (uav_nest_code = #{deviceCode}) and delete_flag = 0

select t.device_code as uavCode, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then a.device_name else rel.device_name end ) as uavName, b.device_code as uavNestCode, (case when length(IFNULL(nrel.device_name, '')) = 0 then b.device_name else nrel.device_name end ) as uavNestName from vm_order_uav_nest_devices t left join vm_uav_nest_device_info b on t.device_code = b.device_code left join vm_uav_device_info_t a on b.device_code = a.uav_nest_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = a.device_code and rel.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = t.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = 1 left join vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t nrel on nrel.device_code = b.device_code and nrel.industry_code = t.industry_code and nrel.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and nrel.delete_flag = '0' and nrel.device_type = 4 where t.delete_flag = 0 and b.delete_flag = 0 and t.ord_status in (0,1,2) ${dataScope}
select user_id as userId from sys_user where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and DEL_FLAG = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO vm_air_line_point_info ( flight_route_id, longitude, latitude, algorithm_code, create_time, create_user, delete_flag ) VALUES
( #{flightRouteId}, #{item.longitude}, #{item.latitude}, #{item.algorithmCodeStr}, NOW(), #{item.createUser}, '0' )
mapper.update: update vm_air_line_compare_photo_t set DELETE_FLAG = 1 where flight_route_Id = #{id};
mapper.select: select c.sensor_size as sensorSize,cm.manufacturer_code as maufacturerCode from vm_uav_camera_lens_param c left join vm_uav_camera_model_t cm on cm.model_code = c.camera_model_code where camera_model_code = #{carmeCode} and lens_name = "广角" and c.delete_flag = 0 limit 1

SELECT t.flight_route_id AS flightRouteId, t.flight_route_name AS flightRouteName, t.kmz_storage_path AS kmzUrl, t.kmz_file_name AS kmzFileName, t.type AS type, t.device_code AS deviceCode, t.update_time AS modifiedTime, t.warning_type_id AS warningTypeId, t.extra_field AS kmzJson, t.access_node AS accessNode, ct.longitude as uavNestLongitude, ct.latitude as uavNestLatitude, dt.longitude as uavLongitude, dt.latitude as uavLatitude, t.uav_Allowed AS uavAllowed, t.snapshot_Id AS snapshotId, t.kmz_access_path AS kmzAccessUrl, t.industry_Code AS industryCode, t.is_expand_watermark AS isExpandWatermark, t.air_mileage AS airMileage FROM vm_air_task_t tt LEFT JOIN vm_air_line_t t on tt.flight_route_id = t.flight_route_id LEFT JOIN vm_uav_nest_device_info ct ON ct.device_code = t.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t dt ON dt.device_code = t.device_code WHERE tt.plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId}

SELECT l.flight_route_id AS flightRouteId, l.flight_route_name AS flightRouteName, l.kmz_storage_path AS kmzUrl, l.kmz_file_name AS kmzFileName, l.kmz_access_path AS kmzAccessUrl, l.type AS type, l.device_code AS deviceCode, l.update_time AS modifiedTime, l.warning_type_id AS warningTypeId, l.extra_field AS kmzJson, l.access_node AS accessNode, l.industry_Code AS industryCode, l.uav_Allowed AS uavAllowed, l.snapshot_Id AS snapshotId, l.is_expand_watermark AS isExpandWatermark, l.air_mileage AS airMileage FROM vm_air_task_t t INNER JOIN vm_air_line_t l ON t.flight_route_id = l.flight_route_id WHERE t.plan_task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1

select manufacturer_code as uavNestType,model_code as uavNestTypeCode,longitude as uavNestLongitude, latitude as uavNestLatitude from vm_uav_nest_device_info where device_code = #{deviceCode} and delete_flag = 0 limit 1

select d.tenant_id,d.industry_code,u.user_id from vm_order_uav_devices d left join sys_user u on u.tenant_id =d.tenant_id left join vm_uav_device_info_t dt on dt.device_code = d.device_code where dt.uav_nest_code = #{deviceCode} and ord_status in (0,1,2) and u.DEL_FLAG = 0

SELECT a.task_id AS taskId,c.algorithm_code AS algorithmCode, c.algorithm_name AS algorithmName FROM vm_air_algorithm_t a LEFT JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t c on a.warning_type_id = c.algorithm_code WHERE a.flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId} and a.status = 0 and a.delete_flag = 0 and c.model_config like '%dict-pushStreamType%'
SELECT count(1) > 0 FROM vm_air_line_t WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId}
SELECT flight_main_type FROM vm_air_line_t WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId} LIMIT 1
